assumptions.name: compact-disconnects-before-abort
assumptions.message: ntfy's compaction guard assumes AgentSession.compact() calls _disconnectFromAgent() BEFORE await this.abort(), so a compaction-aborted run emits agent_settled with no preceding agent_end. That ordering is gone in the installed pi — the ntfy `runEnded` guard (dot_pi/agent/extensions/ntfy/index.ts) may now suppress real notifications or stop suppressing compaction ones. Re-derive the guard.
